I was not able to retrieve the exact "Cash and cash equivalents" line item as reported separately on Sea's consolidated balance sheet (the search tool kept returning the combined "cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash" figure rather than the standalone balance-sheet line).

What I can confirm: As of December 31, 2025, Sea Limited reported **cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash of US$6.4 billion** (specifically US$6,419,467 thousand) [Sea, FY2025, p.107, 141]. However, this combined figure includes restricted cash (e.g., Shopee escrow funds and Monee e-wallet balances) [Sea, FY2025, p.F-30], and the report defines cash and cash equivalents separately from restricted cash.

I do not have the precise standalone "cash and cash equivalents" balance-sheet figure (excluding restricted cash) for December 31, 2025 — I was unable to locate the exact line item from the Consolidated Balance Sheet in the retrieved results, despite searching specifically for it. If you need the precise unrestricted cash and cash equivalents figure, I'd recommend checking the Consolidated Balance Sheet (page F-7 or nearby) directly, as the search only returned section headers for that page without the dollar figures.
